programme.title: NCIS 22 #1

programme.desc: 凡斯準備主持與委內瑞拉的外交會談,小隊被委派調查他一名線人的屍體。

programme.title: 超難搞先生
programme.desc: 一名火爆的鰥夫與新鄰居建立起改變他生活的不可思議友誼。

programme.title: 失憶醫生: 由你掌握 3 #1
programme.desc: 安治阿上任主治醫生的第一天就肩負起新責任,儘管新任行政主管壓力山大,但他始終沒有忘記病人。

programme.title: 失憶醫生: 由你掌握 3 #2
programme.desc: 病房裡的人聽到關於安治阿記憶的消息後心理都很不平衡;阿尼絲擔心恢復安治阿的記憶會擾亂他的新生;達米安奴擔心這個消息會影響嬌莉亞;安治阿越來越興奮。

programme.title: 失憶醫生: 由你掌握 3 #3
programme.desc: 安治阿繼續深入挖掘自己的記憶,並獲得了明確的線索;費夕高受託照顧一位受歡迎的旅遊博主,但他們的相遇預計會引發不少問題。

programme.title: 失憶醫生: 由你掌握 3 #4
programme.desc: 安治阿記憶的搜尋之路似乎陷入死胡同;費夕高在病房裡感到壓力;域卡度面對的一個病例使他陷入危機,並將他與馬天娜的關係推向邊緣。

programme.title: 失憶醫生: 由你掌握 3 #5
programme.desc: 安治阿要求安里高停止治療,因為他發現很難接受新記憶似乎告訴他的事;年輕女孩維她拒絕化療;安治阿和他的團隊必須處理一位他們都非常熟悉的病人。

programme.title: 失憶醫生: 由你掌握 3 #6
programme.desc: 醫生把嬌莉亞捲入來一起尋找記憶,好更瞭解自己的過去;安祖奴的病情逼使馬天娜證明自己,而他的過去也給他帶來了困擾。

programme.title: 失憶醫生: 由你掌握 3 #7
programme.desc: 安治阿似乎因安里高的療法而出現副作用;阿尼絲抓住機會粉碎他對過去的研究;嬌莉亞確信安治阿即使再困難也不應放棄。

programme.title: 失憶醫生: 由你掌握 3 #8
programme.desc: 安治阿最終想出如何找到他所追求的女人,但他需要鼓起勇氣才能做到這一點;域克接手一位不守紀律的私人教練的病例;達米安奴必須處理一位模特兒的住院事宜。

programme.title: 失憶醫生: 由你掌握 3 #9
programme.desc: 安治阿非常害怕瞭解自己過去的秘密;嬌莉亞留下來照顧一位看來有隱情的病人;安里高必須應付芭芭拉的攻擊,她可能不只是迷戀。

programme.title: 失憶醫生: 由你掌握 3 #10
programme.desc: 安治阿不想被機器取代,所以他與人工智能比拼;一個病例逼使馬天娜面對自己的良心;阿尼絲為了保守安治阿的一個秘密,必須做出一個可怕的選擇。

programme.title: 一步一腳印 發現新台灣
programme.desc: 臺灣到處有充滿創意、認真工作的人們,「一步一腳印,發現新臺灣」將呈現出真實而全面的新臺灣精神。

programme.title: 國民大會
programme.desc: 「國民大會」從臺灣的人、臺灣的事,暢談臺灣的故事,以深入淺出,輕鬆幽默的不同面向解讀社會時事的氛圍。

programme.title: 拜託ATM
programme.desc: 極具未來感場景的全新益智綜藝節目《拜託ATM》,結合電玩遊戲概念,挑戰者將透過益智競爭,開啟ATM進行終極解碼遊戲。一場科技與智慧的益智競賽《拜託ATM》由行長胡瓜、襄理Sandra與精英挑戰者攜手打

programme.title: 靈修早晨
programme.desc: 每天早晨透過詩歌安靜心靈,從牧者及嘉賓的分享學習《聖經》中的真理,讓觀眾由淺入深認識信仰,默想《聖經》教導。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 地球深度行IV 鐵証待判
programme.desc: 《地球深度行4之鐵證待判》繼續以遊歷的方式,走進荷蘭、土耳其、約旦、敍利亞,涉及接近50個地點,超過30個已經發生嘅神蹟預言、傳奇故事,以考古和實證,重新解構連科學都不能解釋的千古謎團。 歷年來有無數的考古學家和世界知名的紀錄片頻道,為瞭解開上帝藉著摩西施行神蹟分割紅海這個歷史迷團,他們都不惜花上大

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

programme.title: 如果還有明天3 誰主生死
programme.desc: 死亡,是每一個人必經階段,但當與死亡直接交鋒的時候,大部份人仍然會手足無措。有見《如果還有明天2》的反應理想,創世電視籌備了特別版,訪問多位醫學界專業人士,分別有香港中文大學醫學教授沈祖堯、精神科醫生莊紹賢透過他們切身之痛的經歷,將見證結合醫學知識,剖析人面對死亡時如何提供深層的安慰,讓

programme.title: 福氣教會講道系列
programme.desc: 如何建立健康強盛的教會? 改變社區可以轉化城市? 作為基督徒,我們又如何盡忠地完成普世宣教使命? 一個「幸福小組」,讓教會續步履行三個使命!由台灣高雄福氣教會牧者主講,從《聖經》的話語開始,一起來學習「幸福」智慧!

programme.title: 「創世電視福音主日」-不由你不信之從萬物創造到深邃的愛
programme.desc: 「超闊銀幕震撼影像」遇上「意想不到又大眾化的福音主題」,加上「誠意的款待」會產生極致的「福音體驗」。梁明彪博士分享上帝如何從人類各器官的精密構造,看到上帝創造是多麼奇妙偉大,每個人的出生就是一場最嚴謹的監製,原來正常的生命就是一場神蹟。在領受上帝創造恩典之時,明白祂在創造過程對人的慈愛和關懷。

programme.title: 屬靈教室:蘇穎睿牧師-信心之旅
programme.desc: 希伯來書除了論證耶穌基督的超越性之外,字裡行間隨時都有對猶太信徒的勸勉,因為這些猶太信徒受本族人的壓力,產生許多疑難,信心開始動搖。藉着希伯來書,蘇穎睿牧師帶你走進歷史,閱覽這趟考驗信心之旅。

programme.title: 屬靈教室:劉銳光牧師-羅馬書
programme.desc: 曾擔任香港海外神學院院長12年,在香港、菲律賓和美國洛杉磯有40年牧會經驗的劉銳光牧師,將會深入淺出講解一個關乎基督教信仰核心的經卷─《羅馬書》與今日信徒的關係。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#86粵
programme.desc: 義看見到巴黎留學的「夢中女神」程家敏身影，他又遺失了電子記事簿，有人拾獲致電，尤如義初遇敏的情況。此次卻是索取報酬的不良少女，但義竟又看到敏身影。義赫然發現敏因盜竊被家人所擒，敏竟稱在巴黎遇車禍失憶。

programme.title: 尚食#26粵普
programme.desc: 中秋宴上，紫萍獻上粗陋食物，受太后賞識，暫領掌事一職。子衿因故在吳昭儀處歇宿，恰被朱瞻基看到，拂袖而去。朱瞻基故意冷待子衿，卻又處處看到子衿的影子，遂讓子衿居於寵妃宮殿傳達深意，子衿卻不為所動。

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 鼎植口腔呈獻：齒中守護你粵
阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 鼎爺炮製功夫菜「芋蓉鴨」，單是處理鴨肉便需經過汆水、拉油、蒸香等步驟。鼎爺教路製作芋泥時應選用芋頭的哪部份，搓芋泥時可加入甚麼調味？起鴨肉後釀芋泥，再慢慢淋上滾油，菜式啖啖肉且甘香鬆化。蘆筍益處多，鼎爺以此製作小炒「蘆筍炒牛仔柳」，炒香牛仔柳後，加入蘆筍、鮮百合快炒即成。烹調時如何保持蘆筍翠綠及有光澤？「西湖菜脯牛肉羹」口感豐富，將材料切細的刀功是關鍵，留意鼎爺示範。湯羹以馬蹄粉埋芡，有何好處？

programme.title: 滙豐保險呈獻 :準備退休有乜計粵
programme.desc: 退休是一段嶄新的人生篇章，值得細心規劃與期待。若可提前安排好財務、健康、生活的方向，便能於退休後真正享受自在和安穩。王祖藍、李亞男這對演藝圈的模範夫婦，引領觀眾從不同方面切入，認知退休所需準備，務求可在財務與生活規劃上更周全，得以輕鬆迎接屬於自己的人生新階段。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 呼吸系統科醫生指肺內的結節，大部份都不是腫瘤，如非肺癌風險族群，小於6毫米可以不理。那麼甚麼人士屬於風險一族？此外，結節如變大，做手術切除亦不一定正確？關鍵是抽取組織檢驗的結果，是良性或惡性。歌手涂家堯憶述報名參加《中年好聲音》的掙扎過程，又細談比賽的得着，還透露賽後才正式學唱歌。近年有朋友因抑鬱症而離世，故他盼望藉新歌喚起大眾對精神健康的關注。「睇餸食飯」，小儀師傅示範「升級版櫻花蝦三絲炒瀨」。

programme.title: 醫度講粵
programme.desc: 世衞調查指出，只有10%黃種人的肌膚處於健康狀態，多達60%的都市女人屬敏感肌膚，因此皮膚敏感問題十分值得我們關注。《醫度講》這集請來藝員王菲述說受皮膚敏感問題困擾的情況，並有麥凱婷醫生為大家解構皮膚敏感問題及相關分類，而註冊中醫師何慧欣聯同營養師李澄琳，也會分享與皮膚敏感相關的食療和穴位，記得留意！

programme.title: 五味人生#18粵
programme.desc: 飛揚將安山寫下的自白遺書交給若嵐與永禎看，證明是安山犯罪。勝天得若嵐之助不用到外國讀書，特意買禮物送她，期間與潤月起衝突，永禎竟代勝天道歉，令他大感不滿。雙春與九妹在吳篤村開大牌檔，卻因搶了別人生意，惹來村民臭口祖帶同伙伴挑釁；永禎請金鳳與人相睇，酬勞一百元；永禎竟帶勝天出現……雙春成功說服臭口祖合作經營食肆，生意更繁盛。九妹煮菜誤吃毒物，雙春連日照料；九妹康復推出新湯水，被稱為「夫唱婦隨湯」……

programme.title: 奇妙的動物之海底探險隊粵普
programme.desc: 大海對孩子們來說總有著無限的吸引力，海底深處到底是什麼樣的？存活著哪些動物？它們的生存本領是什麼？一支神秘的海底探險隊正在悄悄集結，將帶著各種各樣的問題去海洋裡尋找答案。

programme.title: 奇妙的動物之海底探險隊粵普
programme.desc: 大海對孩子們來說總有著無限的吸引力，海底深處到底是什麼樣的？存活著哪些動物？它們的生存本領是什麼？一支神秘的海底探險隊正在悄悄集結，將帶著各種各樣的問題去海洋裡尋找答案。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 在香港有機會遇見的白色鸚鵡，觀鳥專家指牠名為小葵花鳳頭鸚鵡，全球數量估計不足二千隻。小朋友若聽到特定聲音，便有機會發現牠們的蹤影。嘉賓又介紹另一種名為鵲鴝的鳥類，是模仿其他鳥叫聲的高手。不少人或曾於清晨被噪鵑的叫聲吵醒，彤彤姐姐嘗試模仿，發出可愛鳥啼聲。噪鵑還有一種習性，會將自己產下的蛋放入其他雀鳥的巢中。嘉賓再介紹一種黑臉噪鶥，黑色的闊臉罩是其明顯特徵；還有一種白腰文鳥，可從甚麼外貌特徵辨別？

programme.title: 天才高球少女粵日
programme.desc: 蜻蛉按照島上慣例，寫了一篇以「最後的暑假」為題的作文，闡述自己的心路歷程。五十嵐認為傳統的指導不適合蜻蛉，求權三讓他負責安排。蜻蛉初中畢業，準備出島，對外面世界充滿期待，同時難掩不安。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 鼎植口腔呈獻：齒中守護你粵
programme.desc: 荃灣一個二手盤，淋浴間滲水至走廊，冷氣機也滴水，還有哪些家居隱患？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵 及 渣打香港呈獻：財富之道粵
programme.desc: 事主疑於上水某屋苑迷路，想經「出路」標示的門口離開時遭保安員呼喝，更被對方以頭部撞擊？攝製隊隨事主向管理處查詢投訴處理情況。準新娘拍攝婚紗照前，經美容師建議做微針療程，未料卻臉部紅腫、疼痛，甚至疑似受細菌感染！婚攝被迫取消，準新娘向美容院追討卻未達共識，更要飽受「爛臉」之苦，身心俱疲……周潤發、梁家輝、郭富城等巨星參演的新片舉行首映禮，眾人暢談演出點滴。健康風險管理是退休規劃要點之一，送上資訊。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2796粵
programme.desc: 敢威惹秀琴生氣，家聰主動充當和事老，背後另有內情。秀琴不為所動，敢威打算為她作特別的表演，並斥重金交由家聰籌備。家聰「不務正業」，令Minnie疲於奔命。某惡人欲控告接龍，她逼家聰同往洽談和解，本以為一切順利，事情卻因家聰先行離去而生變故，Minnie更得罪了該惡人。表演當天，大批記者前往片場採訪，敢威本已準備登場，詎料……惡人亦來到片場，眼見Minnie遭惡人欺負，家聰為救人而作出驚人之舉……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞物業貸款呈獻：正義女神#23粵PG
programme.desc: 惠知在庭上證明警方有人破壞證物鏈的完整性，一切證據不再可信，天雪出獄在望。此時淑樺卻使計阻礙，案件需要重審！惠知深知要改變辯護策略，關鍵在於「紋身疑兇」，在思義等人協助下，案情終見曙光！同時，天雪情緒崩潰欲輕生被送院，惠知與光正心痛萬分。重審前，淑樺發出最後通牒，約見惠知協議認罪協商。惠知嗤之以鼻，絕不會讓天雪承認自己沒有做過之事，談判隨之破裂。重審再開，淑樺呈上新證據狙擊，惟惠知成功反將一軍！

programme.title: 大生意人#18粵普
programme.desc: 李欽和平原跟洋人談判，洋人卻提出無禮要求。南通海塘崩塌，受災無數，瑞麟要修好海塘，但不想李家壟斷鹽業，便讓平原和李欽競爭修海塘。瑞麟上書推薦平原，信中為其洗冤雪恥，保其可實授同進士出身，平原感激涕零。

programme.title: 試真D粵
programme.desc: 美儀姐、朱仔踢走GM往吃潮汕牛肉鍋，吊龍、匙柄、雪花放入火鍋，好味到令朱仔不敢相信是《試真D》行程！美儀姐聽朋友推薦要食鵝頭，逾一千元點吃六年獅頭鵝頭，被指是行程最貴的一碟美食！朱仔直言打開新領域，坤哥還以極限運動作比喻？美儀姐帶隊往潮州「早餐市場」掃街，品嚐油炸鬼、餃子等小食，坤哥再爆食評金句，豆漿似飲豆漿？特地走進農莊，一試「土蝦」名物，要連泥食？坤哥嫌太腥，卻被拍檔回話未見識過真正「腥味」！

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 鼎植口腔呈獻：齒中守護你粵
及時雨信貸呈獻：談判專家#16粵PG
programme.desc: 可人、楊光合力勸服企圖自殺的家全，當家全準備離開天台時，卻意外失足跌死。楊光、可人同受極深的心理創傷，楊光能克服而使壓力得以紓緩，但可人卻難以面對，精神陷入崩潰。簡潔勸可人接受心理治療，但可人拒絕。國棟徹查一宗強姦案，健碩、小強、左輪及素秋均努力追查線索。素秋生病仍堅持工作不敢請假，簡潔提醒國棟多關心下屬。簡潔懷了家聰的孩子，頓時大感矛盾，不想孩子於單親家庭中成長，決定打掉胎兒，國棟勸簡潔，不果。

programme.desc: 飛揚將安山寫下的自白遺書交給若嵐與永禎看，證明是安山犯罪。勝天得若嵐之助不用到外國讀書，特意買禮物送她，期間與潤月起衝突，永禎竟代勝天道歉，令他大感不滿。雙春與九妹在吳篤村開大牌檔，卻因搶了別人生意，惹來村民臭口祖帶同伙伴挑釁；永禎請金鳳與人相睇，酬勞一百元；永禎竟帶勝天出現……雙春成功說服臭口祖合作經營食肆，生意更繁盛。九妹煮菜誤吃毒物，雙春連日照料；九妹康復推出新湯水，被稱為「夫唱婦隨湯」……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#86粵
programme.desc: 義看見到巴黎留學的「夢中女神」程家敏身影，他又遺失了電子記事簿，有人拾獲致電，尤如義初遇敏的情況。此次卻是索取報酬的不良少女，但義竟又看到敏身影。義赫然發現敏因盜竊被家人所擒，敏竟稱在巴黎遇車禍失憶。

programme.title: 尚食#26粵普
programme.desc: 中秋宴上，紫萍獻上粗陋食物，受太后賞識，暫領掌事一職。子衿因故在吳昭儀處歇宿，恰被朱瞻基看到，拂袖而去。朱瞻基故意冷待子衿，卻又處處看到子衿的影子，遂讓子衿居於寵妃宮殿傳達深意，子衿卻不為所動。

programme.title: Sunday靚聲王粵
programme.desc: 民間故事題材的影視作品風靡六、七十年代，片中黃梅調、小調風格因而流行。楊燕、曉華、劉雅麗合唱<戲鳳；凌波再度「梁兄上身」，<訪英台之餘還與汪明荃演繹黃梅調的<十八相送。華娃、奚秀蘭亦分別獻唱。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#87粵
programme.desc: 原來家詩假扮其孖生姊姊敏，向義騙取五萬元後揚長而去。義揚言要找敏問個明白，敏突然到訪向他還錢及求救，原來她近日遇上惡漢追趕。當義知道詩是敏的親妹，更帶她回家避禍。而詩亦改過自新，令眾人另眼相看。

programme.title: 尚食#27粵普
programme.desc: 子衿獲封貴妃，妙賢即向子衿賠罪。善祥發症，宮正司懷疑是藥膳所致，關押了紫萍等人。月華將此事稟報於瞻基，瞻基對紫萍施杖刑，並讓善祥旁聽，子衿匆忙趕至，求瞻基收回成命，善祥於心不忍，最終還尚食局清白。

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 「豉油西餐」選用本地食材卻結合西式煮法，鼎爺這次示範多款中西合璧的滋味。阿爺自製瑞士汁，要加入汽水來增加甜味，奉上香滑「瑞士雞翼」。接着以同一鍋瑞士汁來炒牛河，下鑊前要將河粉逐條分開，有助色澤均勻。想避免黏鑊，又有甚麼秘訣？「港式羅宋湯」材料豐富，先炒香紅菜頭、洋蔥等蔬菜，可令味道更濃郁！此外，採用紅酒與少量羅宋湯料，搭配煲了約一小時的和牛牛尾，並以慢火燜煮的「紅酒燴牛尾」，入味之餘，還入口即溶！

programme.title: 渣打香港呈獻：財富之道粵
programme.desc: 《渣打香港呈獻：財富之道》，每集邀請各界精英與銀行專家，在輕鬆氛圍下暢談財富投資熱話，包括財富管理、AI投資、利率走勢、醫療保險及多元資產配置。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 「目標焦慮症」常見於年輕人，因無法確立人生方向、設立太高的目標而焦慮。精神科醫生指，患者容易於休息時感到內疚、質疑工作意義等，建議透過「微細目標」、減少比較來改善。殿堂級填詞人鄭國江常於歌詞裡傳遞正能量，他憶述與譚詠麟、陳百強、張國榮等巨星合作點滴。鄭Sir笑談與林子祥是「早餐之友」；難忘為梅艷芳創作<似水流年，卻對這歌成為電影片尾曲覺得可惜？「睇餸食飯」，傅季馨師傅帶來香濃惹味的「風沙雞翼」。

programme.title: 醫度講粵
programme.desc: 睡眠不足影響事大，會令人增加心臟病、中風的機會，所以失眠問題值得大家關注。《醫度講》這次請來林秀怡述說如何受失眠問題困擾，也有曹國柱醫生解構失眠的成因與分類，而註冊中醫師何慧欣聯同營養師李澄琳，會分享失眠相關的食療和穴位。

programme.title: 五味人生#19粵
programme.desc: 勝天向父親說發現永禎與金鳳是騙子，問飛揚為何不辭退永禎，飛揚指應好好利用他。金鳳辭任義學教師，勝天挽留金鳳；永禎卻證明金鳳在香港是交際花。若嵐感自己過勞欲服藥調理身子，卻因此病倒。照仁與照義到關家欲收購喜相逢無功而回。中秋將至，之科因到吳篤村隔鄰探親，答應順道載連家眾人去與雙春過節。永禎答應助勝天與金鳳私奔；飛揚突然出現阻止，更指是永禎通風報訊；有女性當街與金鳳糾纏，指她在香港是交際花……

programme.title: 奇妙的動物之海底探險隊粵普
programme.desc: 大海對孩子們來說總有著無限的吸引力，海底深處到底是什麼樣的？存活著哪些動物？它們的生存本領是什麼？一支神秘的海底探險隊正在悄悄集結，將帶著各種各樣的問題去海洋裡尋找答案。

programme.title: 奇妙的動物之海底探險隊粵普
programme.desc: 大海對孩子們來說總有著無限的吸引力，海底深處到底是什麼樣的？存活著哪些動物？它們的生存本領是什麼？一支神秘的海底探險隊正在悄悄集結，將帶著各種各樣的問題去海洋裡尋找答案。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 又來到「WORKOUT 2GETHER」時間，兒童體適能教練Yuki姐姐這回首先引領大家做腿部訓練，會透過後踢腿、弓箭步、深蹲等基礎動作進行。稍為休息後，教練着每人在頭頂上放置豆袋，再聽從指令做動作，同時保持不讓豆袋掉下來，有助提升平衡力與體能。另外，節目亦會播放AI生成動畫《公雞和寶石》的下半部。故事中，公雞認為麥粒比寶石更珍貴，原因值得大家深思。

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 為準備情人節的繪本朗讀義工活動，陽葵的班級今天要進行朗讀練習，至於繪本就是《星光兔公主的情人節》。正當同學們當眾朗讀時，陽葵腦海浮現出不同的演唱會，漸漸沉浸於繪本與演唱會的世界。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 新聞掏寶粵
programme.desc: 香港普羅大眾，過去想買菜購物，大多是去街市，但舊式街市環境污穢，令不少市民望而卻步，一些新型街市的出現，又是否能夠力挽狂瀾呢？超市加入競爭，會否令生意越來越難做？新聞掏寶和大家重溫2002年專題。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 滙豐Premier Elite 呈獻：《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》粵
滙豐保險呈獻 :準備退休有乜計粵
programme.desc: 退休是一段嶄新的人生篇章，值得細心規劃與期待。若可提前安排好財務、健康、生活的方向，便能於退休後真正享受自在和安穩。王祖藍、李亞男這對演藝圈的模範夫婦，引領觀眾從不同方面切入，認知退休所需準備，務求可在財務與生活規劃上更周全，得以輕鬆迎接屬於自己的人生新階段。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2797粵
programme.desc: 壯帶Elaine到某間茶餐廳用餐，被栢菲等人批評。眾人提到壯過於「求其」，建議他嘗試追求生活上的「儀式感」。壯不以為然，其後卻得知Elaine十分重視儀式感。為要慶祝兩人交往一個月，壯打算為Elaine安排儀式感滿滿的特別活動，遂向熊家眾人求助，眾人於是分享經驗……Elaine對壯的表現甚滿意，遂對下次的慶祝活動更加期待。壯為籌備慶祝事宜疲於奔命，怎料Elaine卻有意想不到的轉變……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞物業貸款呈獻：正義女神#24粵PG
programme.desc: 惠知要求傳召新證人，縱然淑樺極力反對，邵文基於證據批准。庭上，惠知步步進逼，以影片為證據，指出兇案現場有第三者！惠知以有力的結案陳詞說服陪審團，天雪無罪釋放。邵文同時要求警方繼續調查，淑樺以為案件早已落幕，可是結果不如人意……光正回到律政司，接手處理「張景翔謀殺案」。偉迪負責跟蹤淑樺，卻被淑樺甩掉。淑樺趕往偏僻村屋，為隱瞞真相不惜一切手段，銷毀證據，卻發現一切惡意的起源，竟與自己有關……

programme.title: 大生意人#19粵普PG
programme.desc: 依梅懇求平原救出李成的舊部，九帥假裝被綁，平原前往談判，成功讓戰俘登船離開。平原和李欽修好海塘，瑞麟設宴慶功，把古母請來，怎料她見到萬堂就昏倒了。瑞麟限平原和李欽十天內把鹽場的事辦好，二人都絞盡腦汁。

programme.title: 試真D粵
programme.desc: 製作組要美儀姐、嘉洛、坤哥往試「熟成刺身」，熟成是熟的，刺身是生的，也有評語讚其新鮮、指稱它不新鮮，究竟真身如何？進店一大陣鹹魚味，食品放入口卻覺得與刺身沒太大分別？朱仔、坤哥偕美儀姐踏入似影城的揭陽古城「掃街」，幾位店主都歡迎試食，潮州三寶、牛丸換來連番「嘩嘩」聲！潮州某間精緻餐廳，「不過不失」都已是四個負評其中一個，應該無伏吧？每道菜都獲大家讚賞，唯一令美儀姐想彈的，是坤哥的失態……

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
及時雨信貸呈獻：談判專家#17粵PG
programme.desc: 簡潔為令欲輕生的未婚媽媽徐婉芳明白孩子是無辜的，說出自己懷孕以來的徬徨，婉芳被感動，簡潔亦決定當單親媽媽。可人未能面對家全之死，向國棟提出暫停談判工作。楊光帶可人見孝武接受治療，惟她心理創傷太深，抗拒治療。孝武轉另一方式使可人舒發抑壓的情緒。簡潔見婉芳父與婉芳男友榮爭吵，始知婉芳曾被色魔施暴，復遭榮拋棄，鼓勵婉芳報警。報章大肆報導簡潔當單親媽媽的負面新聞，更連番追訪她，國棟為幫簡潔避開記者而撞車。

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: Do姐請杜如風、洪永城參與遊戲，還即場品評二人給她的第一印象。兩位旅遊達人見多識廣，很快就寫出答案，最終誰能勝出？曼谷婦女為何清晨便起床準備食物？台北燒肉店的「小鮮肉侍應」會提供甚麼貼心服務？

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 為何首爾某咖啡店的客人總在手機中挑選相片？愛吃天竺鼠的秘魯人把天竺鼠放進哪幅名畫中？鄭丹瑞、米雪見多識廣，要答中問題並不難，只怕農夫在身邊搞破壞！曼谷有何特別造型的甜品令處變不驚的Do姐也不敢一試？

programme.title: 屁屁偵探電影：瓢蟲遺蹟之謎粵日
programme.desc: 點點村出現了罕災，一點雨水都沒有。屁屁丹迪前往調查，結識了一位少女熊貓妲。為了找到熊貓妲的爺爺，兩人一同前往遺蹟；中途雖遇上賊人，但在屁屁偵探的幫助下，兩人終成功令點點村下起雨來。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#88粵
programme.desc: 溢發現送件速度日減，結果查出因重了影響表現，義取笑溢需要買專為肥人而設的「肥仔褲」，而溢去購買時竟遇上亨，二人決定參加男士美容中心的修身療程。當到美容中心，溢卻鬧出不少笑話，竟利用蒸氣熱石來烘三文治。

programme.title: 尚食#28粵普
programme.desc: 子衿發現被瞻基、紫萍所騙，失望又氣憤，隨後又因被禁足勾起往日陰影，竟突然失聲，瞻基卻誤會她是賭氣不願開口認錯。太后以仁孝皇后為例，請求子衿以社稷福祉為先，個人恩怨為後，子衿動容不已，奈何無法言語。

programme.title: 香港本色粵 及 鼎植口腔呈獻：齒中守護你粵
programme.desc: 被列入本港首份非物質文化遺產清單的傳統手藝有不少逐漸式微，但「搭棚的藝術」仍然長青。在天后誕，不少地方會搭出大大小小的戲棚，而堪稱「史上難度最高」的戲棚，位於蒲台島的懸崖。蒲台島那麼大，戲棚為何非建在懸崖邊不可？要裝飾戲棚，傳統的花牌是必然之選。在出身花牌世家的蔡榮基眼中，花牌並非單純是一門生意，而是講究組件、字句、圖案配合的藝術。現今事事講求效率，何以他仍樂意花上兩天時間準備一組字？

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 八角、桂皮、花椒等，皆是鼎爺常用的中式香料，他是根據甚麼條件去選用？尋找仍然承傳的竹篩腸粉蹤跡，菜脯腸粉似是潮州食法，如何將滋味加倍？鼎爺今集專注做兩道「功夫菜」，先有「酒香火焰鴨」，直接於煲內放置材料，分兩次蓋好燜煮，連蠔油亦要分兩次下。最後加米酒做出火焰效果，兼可提升鴨肉香味！另一款美食「魚湯鮮蝦銀針粉」，採用雜魚熬出潔白湯底，還要預備蛋絲巧製。除了用作入味的魚湯，豬油渣亦是「鼎級」點綴。

programme.title: 滙豐保險呈獻 :準備退休有乜計粵
programme.desc: 退休是一段嶄新的人生篇章，值得細心規劃與期待。若可提前安排好財務、健康、生活的方向，便能於退休後真正享受自在和安穩。王祖藍、李亞男這對演藝圈的模範夫婦，引領觀眾從不同方面切入，認知退休所需準備，務求可在財務與生活規劃上更周全，得以輕鬆迎接屬於自己的人生新階段。

programme.title: 滙豐Premier Elite 呈獻：《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》粵
programme.desc: 金融市場瞬息萬變，加上科技發展日新月異，如何影響投資市場？《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》，雲集不同行業專家，剖析市場趨勢，講解金融、投資及理財等話題，務求做到深入淺出，聚焦分析不同議題，為大家捕捉市場先機。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 鼻咽癌的早期病徵包括耳痛、鼻涕倒流、單側鼻塞、鼻涕帶血絲等，臨床腫瘤科醫生提醒要留意這些「警號」，並細說診斷方法。早期鼻咽癌以放射治療為主，晚期會將免疫治療與化療二者結合，再以電療加固，如何發揮出協同效應？手腕內有一條腕管，如因過度勞損而變窄，會壓住重要的「正中神經」。物理治療師概述腕管綜合症與「媽媽手」的分別，並傳授三組簡單動作，有助緩解相關不適。「睇餸食飯」環節，Annie奉上「蔥燒雞扒」。

programme.title: 醫度講粵
programme.desc: 有研究發現當氣溫達到28度或29度之後，每上升1度的死亡人數會上升18%，入院人數亦上升45%。香港夏天非常炎熱，不少人也有中暑經驗。節目邀來江嘉敏細說受中暑問題困擾的情況，也有陳佔耀醫生解構中暑的成因及併發症。此外，註冊中醫師何慧欣、營養師李澄琳，會在這集帶來有助治療中暑的食療與穴位。

programme.title: 五味人生#20粵
programme.desc: 關氏兄弟向街坊指喜相逢所賣菜式全是吉慶樓的外賣，更進入廚房，卻發現是喜伯的外族妻子擔任大廚，悻悻然離開後，永禎才發現是九妹假扮；原來雙春得悉若嵐病倒，兩人偷回鎮上探望。雙春離開關家之際不慎與警察遇上，幸遇上永禎出手解圍。飛揚請來西醫替若嵐診症，發現若嵐的病竟因為曼娣而起。雙春被照義所捉，更在祠堂審問；照仁出現後卻指已出查清雙春與九妹乃是清白。永禎不慎把水濺在父親的遺書上，卻因此發現當中破綻。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子開生日會，媽媽勒令只能邀請五人出席，更指定其中三人為丸尾、花輪和小翠，令小丸子大為頭痛。小丸子想養禾雀，費盡心思終於說服父母，誰知禾雀售罄，小丸子不願等，於是買了十姊妹回家。

programme.title: 奇妙的動物之海底探險隊粵普
programme.desc: 大海對孩子們來說總有著無限的吸引力，海底深處到底是什麼樣的？存活著哪些動物？它們的生存本領是什麼？一支神秘的海底探險隊正在悄悄集結，將帶著各種各樣的問題去海洋裡尋找答案。

programme.title: 奇妙的動物之海底探險隊粵普
programme.desc: 大海對孩子們來說總有著無限的吸引力，海底深處到底是什麼樣的？存活著哪些動物？它們的生存本領是什麼？一支神秘的海底探險隊正在悄悄集結，將帶著各種各樣的問題去海洋裡尋找答案。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 本集「Artspiration」，由喜愛繪畫的玲玲姐姐做導師，並教畫非一般的魚類— 海馬。掌握海馬的腹部、尾部、頭形等細節，就可輕易畫出其輪廓。及後轉用化妝棉為畫作上色，可以印出不同層次的花紋？「開心SHARE」的主題是「媽媽的拿手菜式」，欣賞小朋友的畫作時，大家也發現Emily姐姐特別鍾情番茄料理。雞翼、豬扒則是小朋友的至愛，而醃料和醬汁是重點！講起燒烤，為何下次聚餐一定要約Tiffany姐姐？

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 陽葵與美月獲邀到學生會室，除了學生會成員，陽葵的父親友希，美月的祖父母與維多利亞校長亦都在場。校長之所以召集大家，是為了說明偶像公主空間異變的原因，偶像公主手環的秘密，還有阿紡的真正身份……

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 鼎植口腔呈獻：齒中守護你粵
programme.desc: 青衣一個三房單位，提供不少收納，如何把儲物櫃隱藏起來，避免影響設計？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2798粵
programme.desc: 容儀應邀擔任某婦女團體的演講嘉賓，因眼妝出問題，被網民嘲笑她「反白眼」，更因沒人提點她，而被質疑人品。出於某些原因，容儀懷疑秀琴即使察覺她的妝容有問題，仍故意讓她出醜。容儀嘗試為自己平反，但毫無成效，更遭不少人當面嘲笑，幸獲天娥為她出頭。天娥原來需為容儀出醜負上責任，想到一個為容儀解困的特別方法。其後，容儀不再被人嘲笑，但「反白眼」亦為她帶來一些意想不到的效果……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞物業貸款呈獻：正義女神#25粵PG
programme.desc: (大結局)案件開審，光正率先傳召偉迪上庭，但淑樺指偉迪心存偏見，稍佔上風。庭審後，邵文為了測試偉迪的口供屬實與否，來到案發現場測試，遇到惠知。邵文漸漸被惠知影響，開始追求真相。案件陷入僵局之際，光正傳召一人上庭，正是惠知！原來惠知收到一神秘郵包，裡面有指證真兇的關鍵證據。只有惠知心領神會，知道寄出郵包之人是誰……眾人回歸原本的生活，惠知復職回到少年法庭，而她不再是單打獨鬥，身邊已多了一班同伴。

programme.title: 大生意人#20粵普PG
programme.desc: 平原到鹽業公會和鹽商商議對付李萬堂的辦法，當場宣佈和他們三七分帳，鹽商紛紛支持；平原買便宜的四川井鹽打價格戰，李欽得知後利用漕幫劫古平原鹽船；李萬堂勸李欽不要和平原對著幹，即使他贏了，也贏不過朝廷…

programme.title: 試真D粵
programme.desc: 有街邊小店主打多款肉丸，大過拳頭的「魚雷」卻只適合打卡？牛筋丸、胡椒豬肚丸等真材實料又彈牙，朱仔、坤哥堂食兼帶走。即叫即煎潮式蠔烙，雖然蠔新鮮大粒，入口卻沒記憶點？眼利的美儀姐還發現店方用雞蛋非鴨蛋，加上舊油反覆烹炸，難免扣分！魚飯亦是潮汕經典美食，養殖巴浪魚比野生還貴？團隊深入魚市場，一嚐魚飯「天花板」。吃到爆籽魷魚，坤哥「無腦」提問被美儀姐直指失禮！眾主持暢談「難忘一試」，帶出《試真D》精神。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 鼎植口腔呈獻：齒中守護你粵
及時雨信貸呈獻：談判專家#18粵PG
programme.desc: 可人得武的治療下，心理創傷漸癒。武的女友Joyce，乃當公關工作，經常與異性有親密接觸，更不時被報章刊登與異性的緋聞，惹武的家人不滿。棟上司韋要棟盡快破強姦案，棟施壓予碩等人加緊徹查。碩查得色魔喜用攝錄機拍下施暴過程，遂從攝影學會入手調查。潔看穿棟對此案甚為著緊，勸棟避免給自己及下屬過多壓力。棟對潔的一番話有所啟發，對碩、強等人態度稍有改變。武見Joyce與一男子親熱，追問下Joyce反提出分手。武失戀顯得悶悶不樂，幸得可人開解。武為可人治療期間，二人互生好感。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 情侶偶爾鬥氣「耍花槍」有助增進感情，如果弄假成真搞出「大龍鳳」便傷了和氣，大學講師廖舜禧、掌故專家鄭寶鴻分別細談兩俗語的由來。舜禧亦會講解源於桌球評述用語的「符碌」（僥倖）。手製小提琴放滿整間小店，場面令人「姥姥進大觀園－ 眼花撩亂」。張惠雅跟老闆學做小提琴，可會弄得「亂彈琴－ 冇譜」？年輕小伙子畢業後當上打金師，希望活化昔日香港傳統行業。精心傑作設計既新潮又富心思，絕非「金漆馬桶」， 虛有其表！

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 維修鐘錶講眼力又考記性，鐘錶店老闆在上海街扎根半世紀，技術精湛，絕非「做一日和尚敲一日鐘－ 得過且過」！老闆還介紹店內擁有逾百年歷史的錶撞、錶座。香港製衣業曾興旺一時，出售衣車的商店開得其門如市；「衣車叔叔」細談行業興衰史。重陽節的登高習俗呈現中國傳統孝道，「佛山孝子」登高竟被視為虛情假意？「沙頭角村長個女」，到底是男是女？另外，中文講師廖舜禧試從中式建築學問解構人際關係，要做個有承擔的「架樑」！

programme.title: 搗蛋拉茶鋪
programme.desc: 熱愛拉茶的老闆，和自信滿滿的服務生狗狗，在飄著香氣的拉茶鋪裡享受著愜意的時光。然而一切平靜，都被一隻搗蛋的猴子破壞了！為了趕走猴子，狗狗與猴子的戰鬥即將展開！

programme.desc: 熱愛拉茶的老闆，和自信滿滿的服務生狗狗，在飄著香氣的拉茶鋪裡享受著愜意的時光。然而一切平靜，都被一隻搗蛋的猴子破壞了！為了趕走猴子，狗狗與猴子的戰鬥即將展開！

programme.title: 搗蛋拉茶鋪

programme.title: 海鸚出任務
programme.desc: 一顆從天而降的流星，改變了四隻海鸚的平凡生活，讓他們得到了超乎想像的超能力－－速度、力量、智慧與共情。在導師的指導和幫助下，他們組成超級英雄團隊拯救世界，對抗邪惡的海象博士奧托！

programme.title: 海鸚出任務
programme.desc: 一顆從天而降的流星，改變了四隻海鸚的平凡生活，讓他們得到了超乎想像的超能力－－速度、力量、智慧與共情。在導師的指導和幫助下，他們組成超級英雄團隊拯救世界，對抗邪惡的海象博士奧托！

programme.title: 人偶之家
programme.desc: 【丈夫經商失敗！崔明吉調包財閥孫女只為讓女兒入豪門】琴英淑是一位愛女心切的母親，性格溫厚，在丈夫生意失敗時，她也從不抱怨，自願到殷會長的家裡擔任管家。女兒京慧出生時便被診斷出心臟疾病，當時家境也很難提供好的醫療資源。在一場車禍中，她意外的將女兒京慧，與財閥孫女世妍互相掉包身分，本該是千金小姐的世妍也因此變為平凡人，在百貨擔任精品店職員，而京慧更是直接躍升為財團富三代，然而某一天世妍得知真相，發現原本屬於她的富貴人生全被京慧奪走，憤怒之下她改名換姓，決定拿回屬於她的一切。

programme.title: 等待京道
programme.desc: 【朴敘俊回歸攜手《魷魚2》元志安《等待京道》譜十年宿命戀】十年後的重逢，讓李京道與徐智友再度陷入愛情的漩渦。曾是彼此初戀的兩人，如今一個是追尋真相的記者，一個是醜聞風暴中的名門繼承人。再見面時，他們早已不是年少時的模樣，卻依然在對方身上看見過去的自己。愛情與現實的距離，在一次次試探與退讓間拉扯，他們明知前方滿是荊棘，仍選擇再次並肩。

programme.title: 暖陽之下
programme.desc: 【溫馨陸劇/二寶＆事業該選誰？ 都市夫妻的兩難抉擇！】宋思凝懷著夢想隻身來到北京，經過多年打拼終於成為公司的人力總監，與創意公司總經理李俊龍成為夫妻，並育有一兒，日子過得幸福美滿。但在婚育觀上，兩人的想法有極大的分歧，經常為了女兒的教育問題爭吵，李俊龍希望能與思凝生育二寶，然而正值事業上升期的思凝，面臨自我實現與家庭的兩難衝突，在大都會生活的兩人又該如何抉擇呢？

programme.title: 白夜童話
programme.desc: 【《紳士與小姐》朴荷娜演技狂飆復仇拋夫棄子生母】從小遭母親拋棄，加上父親早逝，白夜與哥哥相依為命，性格堅強好勝的她總對哥哥百般依賴，也因嫉妒哥哥與大嫂的好感情，生活中常常刁難懷孕的大嫂，搞得哥哥十分頭疼。某天哥哥與生母連絡上，面對母親拒絕相認，哥哥內心大受打擊，一晃神就因交通意外不幸離世，得知此事的白夜便將所有憤怒轉向母親，展開一系列的報復計畫。

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 我把社長解鎖了
programme.desc: 【人氣網漫改編，影帝朴星雄解密手機AI的技術奇幻職場劇！】國內市占率最高的科技公司創辦人天才CEO金成柱，因突發事件被殺手追殺成了謀殺案受害者，靈魂尚未離開人世而換個方式存活在剛大學畢業出社會朴仁成的手機內。為找出死亡的真相以及守住公司的一切，成了代理的CEO開始兩人的合作。

programme.title: Remember-兒子的戰爭
programme.desc: 【俞承豪為父申冤，朴敏英成為他正義路上的唯一靠山！！】徐振宇擁有過目不忘的記憶力，為了替被誣陷為殺人犯的父親申冤成為了律師，與權勢貪腐正面對抗。與堅守正義的檢察官李仁雅，從質疑到並肩作戰，成為振宇最堅強的後盾。就在逐步逼近真相時，卻發現自己正逐漸失去記憶。他們攜手在權力夾縫中拚搏，在時間與遺忘賽跑，只為守護真相與心中那份信念與愛。

programme.title: 君九齡
programme.desc: 九齡公主生性善良，喜好醫術，一場陰謀使得她失去至親，骨肉分離，容貌大變。為了查清真相報仇雪恨，九齡隱姓埋名一直蟄伏，靠著堅強的毅力和意志力，苦練技藝，不放過任何蛛絲馬跡，最終發現這場陰謀背後還有一段不為人知的皇室辛秘。知曉真相後的九齡，回到京城，在兇手不斷的騷擾和攻擊中建立了醫館九齡堂，濟世救人，受人尊崇。與此同時，朱瓚與清貴公子寧雲釗、前夫陸雲旗、方家獨子方承宇，身份各異、關係複雜的四人，陷入了以九齡為核心的感情漩渦。誰才是九齡的真命天子？

programme.title: Remember-兒子的戰爭
programme.desc: 【俞承豪為父申冤，朴敏英成為他正義路上的唯一靠山！！】徐振宇擁有過目不忘的記憶力，為了替被誣陷為殺人犯的父親申冤成為了律師，與權勢貪腐正面對抗。與堅守正義的檢察官李仁雅，從質疑到並肩作戰，成為振宇最堅強的後盾。就在逐步逼近真相時，卻發現自己正逐漸失去記憶。他們攜手在權力夾縫中拚搏，在時間與遺忘賽跑，只為守護真相與心中那份信念與愛。

programme.title: 請叫我總監
programme.desc: 【《錦心似玉》譚松韻、《楚喬傳》林更新，秘書與總裁的職場愛情喜劇！】寧檬的夢想是成為一位投資總監，畢業後實際工作卻與夢想越來越遠。上司陸既明是一位業務能力強大的投資總裁，也不認為寧檬會成功。下定決心離開的寧檬因緣際會進入鷹石投資重新開始。一直看著寧檬的陸既明，在每次重要關頭還是會拉他一把，幫助她度過難關，兩人的相處，隨著一次次的突發事件心靠得越來越近。

programme.desc: 【俞承豪為父申冤，朴敏英成為他正義路上的唯一靠山！！】徐振宇擁有過目不忘的記憶力，為了替被誣陷為殺人犯的父親申冤成為了律師，與權勢貪腐正面對抗。與堅守正義的檢察官李仁雅，從質疑到並肩作戰，成為振宇最堅強的後盾。就在逐步逼近真相時，卻發現自己正逐漸失去記憶。他們攜手在權力夾縫中拚搏，在時間與遺忘賽跑，只為守護真相與心中那份信念與愛。

programme.title: 請叫我總監
programme.desc: 【《錦心似玉》譚松韻、《楚喬傳》林更新，秘書與總裁的職場愛情喜劇！】寧檬的夢想是成為一位投資總監，畢業後實際工作卻與夢想越來越遠。上司陸既明是一位業務能力強大的投資總裁，也不認為寧檬會成功。下定決心離開的寧檬因緣際會進入鷹石投資重新開始。一直看著寧檬的陸既明，在每次重要關頭還是會拉他一把，幫助她度過難關，兩人的相處，隨著一次次的突發事件心靠得越來越近。

programme.desc: 哈利是一個年輕的魔術師，發明各種魔術吸引觀眾，但常常發揮不好。為了進入魔術學院，請邦尼作為他的道具兔子進行表演，沒想到卻反而被邦尼搶了風頭，兩人意外一起成為了魔術學院的學生，開始吵吵鬧鬧的歡樂日常。

programme.title: 人偶之家
programme.desc: 【丈夫經商失敗！崔明吉調包財閥孫女只為讓女兒入豪門】琴英淑是一位愛女心切的母親，性格溫厚，在丈夫生意失敗時，她也從不抱怨，自願到殷會長的家裡擔任管家。女兒京慧出生時便被診斷出心臟疾病，當時家境也很難提供好的醫療資源。在一場車禍中，她意外的將女兒京慧，與財閥孫女世妍互相掉包身分，本該是千金小姐的世妍也因此變為平凡人，在百貨擔任精品店職員，而京慧更是直接躍升為財團富三代，然而某一天世妍得知真相，發現原本屬於她的富貴人生全被京慧奪走，憤怒之下她改名換姓，決定拿回屬於她的一切。

programme.title: 等待京道
programme.desc: 【朴敘俊回歸攜手《魷魚2》元志安《等待京道》譜十年宿命戀】十年後的重逢，讓李京道與徐智友再度陷入愛情的漩渦。曾是彼此初戀的兩人，如今一個是追尋真相的記者，一個是醜聞風暴中的名門繼承人。再見面時，他們早已不是年少時的模樣，卻依然在對方身上看見過去的自己。愛情與現實的距離，在一次次試探與退讓間拉扯，他們明知前方滿是荊棘，仍選擇再次並肩。

programme.title: 暖陽之下
programme.desc: 【溫馨陸劇/二寶＆事業該選誰？ 都市夫妻的兩難抉擇！】宋思凝懷著夢想隻身來到北京，經過多年打拼終於成為公司的人力總監，與創意公司總經理李俊龍成為夫妻，並育有一兒，日子過得幸福美滿。但在婚育觀上，兩人的想法有極大的分歧，經常為了女兒的教育問題爭吵，李俊龍希望能與思凝生育二寶，然而正值事業上升期的思凝，面臨自我實現與家庭的兩難衝突，在大都會生活的兩人又該如何抉擇呢？

programme.title: 白夜童話
programme.desc: 【《紳士與小姐》朴荷娜演技狂飆復仇拋夫棄子生母】從小遭母親拋棄，加上父親早逝，白夜與哥哥相依為命，性格堅強好勝的她總對哥哥百般依賴，也因嫉妒哥哥與大嫂的好感情，生活中常常刁難懷孕的大嫂，搞得哥哥十分頭疼。某天哥哥與生母連絡上，面對母親拒絕相認，哥哥內心大受打擊，一晃神就因交通意外不幸離世，得知此事的白夜便將所有憤怒轉向母親，展開一系列的報復計畫。

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 我把社長解鎖了
programme.desc: 【人氣網漫改編，影帝朴星雄解密手機AI的技術奇幻職場劇！】國內市占率最高的科技公司創辦人天才CEO金成柱，因突發事件被殺手追殺成了謀殺案受害者，靈魂尚未離開人世而換個方式存活在剛大學畢業出社會朴仁成的手機內。為找出死亡的真相以及守住公司的一切，成了代理的CEO開始兩人的合作。

programme.title: Remember-兒子的戰爭
programme.desc: 【俞承豪為父申冤，朴敏英成為他正義路上的唯一靠山！！】徐振宇擁有過目不忘的記憶力，為了替被誣陷為殺人犯的父親申冤成為了律師，與權勢貪腐正面對抗。與堅守正義的檢察官李仁雅，從質疑到並肩作戰，成為振宇最堅強的後盾。就在逐步逼近真相時，卻發現自己正逐漸失去記憶。他們攜手在權力夾縫中拚搏，在時間與遺忘賽跑，只為守護真相與心中那份信念與愛。

programme.title: 君九齡
programme.desc: 九齡公主生性善良，喜好醫術，一場陰謀使得她失去至親，骨肉分離，容貌大變。為了查清真相報仇雪恨，九齡隱姓埋名一直蟄伏，靠著堅強的毅力和意志力，苦練技藝，不放過任何蛛絲馬跡，最終發現這場陰謀背後還有一段不為人知的皇室辛秘。知曉真相後的九齡，回到京城，在兇手不斷的騷擾和攻擊中建立了醫館九齡堂，濟世救人，受人尊崇。與此同時，朱瓚與清貴公子寧雲釗、前夫陸雲旗、方家獨子方承宇，身份各異、關係複雜的四人，陷入了以九齡為核心的感情漩渦。誰才是九齡的真命天子？

programme.title: Remember-兒子的戰爭
programme.desc: 【俞承豪為父申冤，朴敏英成為他正義路上的唯一靠山！！】徐振宇擁有過目不忘的記憶力，為了替被誣陷為殺人犯的父親申冤成為了律師，與權勢貪腐正面對抗。與堅守正義的檢察官李仁雅，從質疑到並肩作戰，成為振宇最堅強的後盾。就在逐步逼近真相時，卻發現自己正逐漸失去記憶。他們攜手在權力夾縫中拚搏，在時間與遺忘賽跑，只為守護真相與心中那份信念與愛。

programme.title: 請叫我總監
programme.desc: 【《錦心似玉》譚松韻、《楚喬傳》林更新，秘書與總裁的職場愛情喜劇！】寧檬的夢想是成為一位投資總監，畢業後實際工作卻與夢想越來越遠。上司陸既明是一位業務能力強大的投資總裁，也不認為寧檬會成功。下定決心離開的寧檬因緣際會進入鷹石投資重新開始。一直看著寧檬的陸既明，在每次重要關頭還是會拉他一把，幫助她度過難關，兩人的相處，隨著一次次的突發事件心靠得越來越近。

programme.desc: 九齡公主生性善良，喜好醫術，一場陰謀使得她失去至親，骨肉分離，容貌大變。為了查清真相報仇雪恨，九齡隱姓埋名一直蟄伏，靠著堅強的毅力和意志力，苦練技藝，不放過任何蛛絲馬跡，最終發現這場陰謀背後還有一段不為人知的皇室辛秘。知曉真相後的九齡，回到京城，在兇手不斷的騷擾和攻擊中建立了醫館九齡堂，濟世救人，受人尊崇。與此同時，朱瓚與清貴公子寧雲釗、前夫陸雲旗、方家獨子方承宇，身份各異、關係複雜的四人，陷入了以九齡為核心的感情漩渦。誰才是九齡的真命天子？

programme.title: Remember-兒子的戰爭
programme.desc: 【俞承豪為父申冤，朴敏英成為他正義路上的唯一靠山！！】徐振宇擁有過目不忘的記憶力，為了替被誣陷為殺人犯的父親申冤成為了律師，與權勢貪腐正面對抗。與堅守正義的檢察官李仁雅，從質疑到並肩作戰，成為振宇最堅強的後盾。就在逐步逼近真相時，卻發現自己正逐漸失去記憶。他們攜手在權力夾縫中拚搏，在時間與遺忘賽跑，只為守護真相與心中那份信念與愛。

programme.title: 請叫我總監
programme.desc: 【《錦心似玉》譚松韻、《楚喬傳》林更新，秘書與總裁的職場愛情喜劇！】寧檬的夢想是成為一位投資總監，畢業後實際工作卻與夢想越來越遠。上司陸既明是一位業務能力強大的投資總裁，也不認為寧檬會成功。下定決心離開的寧檬因緣際會進入鷹石投資重新開始。一直看著寧檬的陸既明，在每次重要關頭還是會拉他一把，幫助她度過難關，兩人的相處，隨著一次次的突發事件心靠得越來越近。

programme.title: 我把社長解鎖了
programme.desc: 【人氣網漫改編，影帝朴星雄解密手機AI的技術奇幻職場劇！】國內市占率最高的科技公司創辦人天才CEO金成柱，因突發事件被殺手追殺成了謀殺案受害者，靈魂尚未離開人世而換個方式存活在剛大學畢業出社會朴仁成的手機內。為找出死亡的真相以及守住公司的一切，成了代理的CEO開始兩人的合作。

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Sam the Snowplough clears the streets
programme.desc: Lilly and Tom are stuck in the snow! Troy selects the most perfect truck for the job: Sam the Snowplough!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - OCTO-DANCE! ROOKIE AND THE OCTOPUS
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SPRING, SUMMER, FALL & WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOUNCE, REBOUND - SCORE! ROOKIE AND THE GIRAFFE
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.title: RoboFuse - RoboFuse - Stuck in Mud
programme.desc: Zitron blocked the road with mud, and cars are getting stuck! Rodeo and Booster merge in an attempt to stop him.

programme.title: RoboFuse - RoboFuse - Flying Shark
programme.desc: It's Rodeo's birthday! Zitron's present—a flying shark—goes wild and turns on the guests. Robo comes to the rescue with Carrie's help.

programme.title: RoboFuse - RoboFuse - Saving the Parade
programme.desc: It’s Ben’s Parade in Car City. Zitron escapes from jail, planning to ruin the fun, but Robo foils his plan.

programme.title: Chefclub Kids

programme.title: VIP Pets
programme.desc: We are the VIP Pets! The coolest pets with a passion for hair! We are best friends and together we will discover lots of beautiful hairstyles and go on exciting adventures!

programme.title: Om Nom Stories
programme.desc: Sweet tooth Om Nom is wandering Around the world, eats a lot of candies and tries to find his Dream job. Watch his adventures and solve different puzzles on the way!

programme.title: Ryan Defrates
programme.desc: Ryan Defrates

programme.title: Grojband
programme.desc: The story about 12 year old Corey that emotionally torments his sister so that she will write the ultimate lyrics for his garage band.

programme.title: Everybody Loves a Moose
programme.desc: An oddball buddy series between an over ambitious boy, Jack and his pal Moose, a melodramatic self-confessed expert in everything. Except he isn't! Despite his best intentions, he always messes up and although Jack may not get what he want, you can't help being sucked in by Moose's relentless optimism and zest for life!

programme.title: Tom's Car Wash
programme.desc: Tom loves caring for his friends; they can always count on Tom to tow them back to his car wash, where they're guaranteed to leave sparking!

programme.title: Eliot Kid
programme.desc: When a tooth falling out turns into a hunt for the “giant mouse”, when the city’s sewers transform into Indiana Jones’ white rapids or when a trip to the toilets becomes an expedition to a haunted house, well then you’ve entered the wonderful world of Eliot Kid!

programme.title: Pumpkin Reports
programme.desc: Max Green’s new brother and sister are aliens sent to Earth as the advance party for an invasion - and he’s the only one who can stop them turning humans into unwilling slave-gardeners.

programme.title: Ebb and Flo
programme.desc: The world of Ebb and Flo is seen through Ebb’s eyes and Ebb reveals all the emotions grown-ups try to hide. Flo doesn’t think of Ebb as a dog, and Ebb doesn’t think of Flo as a small human, they just are the best of friends. Until Bird arrives to lovingly disrupt Ebb’s world. Ebb and Flo’s home is an old boat moored by the beach. Things Couldn’t Be Better!

programme.title: Cyboars
programme.desc: Part Machine, Part Boar, All Hero!

programme.title: Princess Play Time
programme.desc: The proud Princess likes to do things her own way, but her antics are always joined by her restless brother, Prince, who tends to turn everything topsy-turvy. Any playtime in their room transforms into a fantastic journey through unusual worlds: the children arrange a picnic on the Moon, conduct a detective investigation in a toy city, or search for pirate treasures on islands! Although initially, the Princess and Prince seem to clash and compete, by the end, they always find joy in each other's company and that of their cherished dog, Bona.

programme.title: Talking Tom and Friends

programme.title: Monster Town

programme.title: Ollie! The Boy Who Became What He Ate
programme.desc: Ollie is a 6-year-old with a massive imagination, often lost in his own world - flipping, sliding, climbing and rocket-blasting through the house, practicing at being the master of all things. But even masters need to stop and refuel. When meals or snack time interrupt Ollie’s play, he finds himself confronted with the real challenge of childhood; trying new food. To escape his predicament, Ollie uses his magic spoon to transport himself, along with his sister Poppy, and her stuffy Nummy, to a food planet filled with adventure and the very food Ollie stuck his spoon into.

programme.desc: Being an ‘only lamb in the flock’ Timmy has been used to getting his own way. Now for the first time Timmy is going to have to learn to get along with other little animals. Timmy is a gifted little footballer who needs to learn that it’s not enough to kick the ball – you have to pass it too. programme.desc: When Egg, the cheeky little chick, goes on the run again, Duggee whistles to get him back. Hang on a minute Duggee, what was that noise? A whistle? The squirrels want to learn how to whistle.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Shape Badge
programme.desc: It is a lovely day and the squirrels are playing outside. They are playing the shape game. Working out which shape goes where is quite tricky.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Juice Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is going to make the squirrels juice from the garden. Whilst picking the fruit, the squirrels meet a little bug, full of woes about being too small.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - What's Hot?
programme.desc: Billy and the Sillies introduce a visit to chicken A&amp;E, the Squirrels build a bug house, Norrie has her chance to shine, and the Penguins give facts about what's hot and what's not.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - I'm Hungry
programme.desc: King Tiger and the Jelly wonder what Duggee has planned for today. Tag wants a snack, Enid has a musical cheese chase, and Norrie has a haircut.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Potato Time
programme.desc: At Squirrel Club, Duggee forgets how to woof, Duggly comes to visit, Roly celebrates Potato Time, and Billy teaches everyone the Bugatron dance!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Song of Peace
programme.desc: Betty recalls the first time she pushed the red button, the Squirrels explore a range of emotions with Happy, Angry Bull tells a not-so-sleepy bedtime story, and the gerbils sing.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Squirrel Babies
programme.desc: Spring has sprung! There are cute baby animals to meet and frolic with.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Shops
programme.desc: Playing 'Shops' is the best game ever for Bluey and her friends - if they can ever get started! With Bluey questioning the rules and changing who's who, they might be here all day!

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Wagon Ride
programme.desc: Bluey can't wait to get to the monkey bars as Dad takes her and Bingo on a wagon ride to the park. But her patience is tested when Dad keeps stopping to chat with other grown-ups.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - The Beach
programme.desc: As Mum goes for a walk along the beach, Bluey runs to catch up with her. Along the way, she has a series of encounters that both excite and test her in her first solo adventure.

programme.title: Andy's Global Adventures (S1) - Emperor Penguins
programme.desc: Andy takes Kip on a wild adventure to see emperor penguins in Antarctica. He huddles up in a group of penguins to try and stay warm, and even finds a cosy spot under one of the parents.

programme.title: Andy's Global Adventures (S1) - Emperor Penguins
programme.desc: Andy takes Kip on a wild adventure to see emperor penguins in Antarctica. He huddles up in a group of penguins to try and stay warm, and even finds a cosy spot under one of the parents.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Diary Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels find a dusty, old book behind a cupboard... it's Duggee's diary from when he was a teenager! The Squirrels are keen to write diaries of their own.

programme.title: The Dream of the Red Chamber
programme.desc: Adapted from the most widely read and filmed novel in Chinese history, this version is said to be the most successful one. Betty Loh's looks, demeanour and aura in her portrayal of Lin Dai Yu has won her the epithet "Classic Beauty".

programme.title: Shaolin Abbot
programme.desc: Monk Chi San is sent by his Shaolin Master to learn a special kung fu skill from a Wu Dang priest. He gets embroiled in a fight between the Qing and Ming camps along the way, and has to gather disciples to rebuild the burnt Shaolin temple at the same time.

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: This is a love story between an alluring fairy, Seventh Sister, who comes down from heaven to experience life in 70's Hong Kong, and a man who is running a debt laden orphanage. A heartless tycoon plans to take over the orphanage for its land but has to deal with Seventh Sister's magical powers as she aims to protect it from falling into his hands!

programme.title: My Young Auntie
programme.desc: An elderly landowner marries young Dai Nan to keep his inheritance away from his unscrupulous nephew before he dies. When Dai Nan brings along the deed to meet his other nephew, a series of amusing incidents happen with this "young" auntie, the nephew and his son. Kara Hui won Best Actress in the first Hong Kong Film Awards for her role as Dai Nan.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung meets a famous courtesan in Suzhou and in order to spend as much time as possible with her, he builds a direct underground tunnel into the Forbidden City. The emperor's sudden appearances through this direct access shock his people but it is also at this time that he helps the needy and cracks the gambling business in Suzhou.

programme.title: King Gambler
programme.desc: This film was actually a lively forerunner to the gambling film craze, which eventually swept Asian cinema. Here, it's cardsharp versus cardsharp with a lot more kung-fu action, in a battle of wits and fists to become the king of the casino. The double stings and triple crosses raise in complexity and imagination until what started as an unusual box office risk became a top ten hit of 1976.

programme.title: The Love Eterne
programme.desc: Ying Tai disguises herself as a boy to go to school and falls hopelessly in love with her classmate, Shan Bo. After Shan Bo realizes her true identity, he proposes marriage to Ying Tai. However, they are kept apart as she is engaged to another man. Knowing Shan Bo died in despair, Ying Tai is in deep sorrow and kills herself at his grave.

programme.title: Angel with the Iron Fists
programme.desc: Lo Wei directs and stars as the chief detective in this gripping thriller; playing alongside Lily Ho, who excels in the role of an undercover avenger that can fight as well as she flirts! Caught between the crime bosses known as Baldhead and Black Widow, she only has four choices: punch, kick, shoot or bombard with explosives!

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung goes incognito to mix with his people and understand their needs. He encounters many strange things along the way, including being arrested and nearly beheaded. Who will save him?

programme.title: Lady With A Sword
programme.desc: Swordswoman Feng tries to find a group of villains responsible for her eldest sister's death, but is shocked to discover that her fiance, Jin, is one of them. At the same time, Jin's mother and the two other killers are planning to kill Feng. Can Feng fight back and take her revenge?

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase
programme.desc: It's a fun and wild romp that mixes pleasure with pleasure. A nightclub owner, playboy Peter Chen Ho, has his ways with three sisters while gallivanting across Asia. Each one has a dangling relationship to save - ensuring a series of mishaps and comic moments.

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre 2
programme.desc: Only by bringing together the powerful Heaven Sword and the mighty Dragon Sabre can six martial arts sects struggling for supremacy be saved in this thrilling sequel to Chu Yuan's original hit.

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Hun's warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself.

programme.title: The Pirate
programme.desc: Pirate Chang Pao Chai discovers a leak in his ship after a successful raid on a foreign merchant ship. He goes ashore to get materials to patch up his ship, but encounters corrupt Qing officials oppressing the poor peasants. A good man at heart, he decides to help the peasants and gain a reputation of being a great pirate in the process.

programme.title: The Pirate
programme.desc: Pirate Chang Pao Chai discovers a leak in his ship after a successful raid on a foreign merchant ship. He goes ashore to get materials to patch up his ship, but encounters corrupt Qing officials oppressing the poor peasants. A good man at heart, he decides to help the peasants and gain a reputation of being a great pirate in the process.

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 years ago. But when Buddhist monk Fa Hai finds out about the union, the pair is forced to split...

programme.title: Magnificent Wanderers
programme.desc: Lin and his two friends are traveling patriots who vow to stand up against violence and fight for justice. They meet a rich young man Chu by chance one day and the four become best friends. When a foreign prince plots to possess Chu's family fortune and goes after him, Lin and friends go all out to help Chu fight against the villain.

programme.title: Bat Without Wings
programme.desc: The Bat Without Wings, a notorious rapist-murderer, has returned after a five-year absence. A young swordsman and a convoy master investigate the case and suspect that the Bat may be framed. A saying goes that a treasure map is hidden under the Bat's knife, so they try to use that to hunt the real culprit...

programme.title: Les Belles
programme.desc: Acknowledged as one of the greatest Hong Kong musicals, this lavish movie starring Linda Lin, who won Best Actress for her performance, infuses its wispy plot with style and wit, and the results are pure pleasure.

programme.title: Ambitious Kung Fu Girl
programme.desc: Si Si, a spoiled and naive rich girl with only basic kung fu training, becomes enchanted by the legends of the fearless hero Qin Ge. Determined to escape her father's arranged marriage, she disguises herself as a man and sets out to find him, hoping to challenge Qin Ge-only to be drawn into a deadly plot within the criminal underworld.

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: Brotherhood
programme.desc: Liu serves his triad society loyally and tries to live a respectable life, but over time his good intentions lead him to an all-out gang war with a startling conclusion.

programme.title: The Big Sting
programme.desc: Three buddies find a rare artifact known as the Double-Faced God but are poisoned by Lady Wu who steals the treasure from them. Before they die, they get their wives to promise to train their children to take back what is rightfully theirs. These kids grow up to exact a vengeance that turns out to be more hilarious than horrific in this comedy.

programme.title: Shaolin Mantis
programme.desc: The Emperor orders Feng to find proofs of Master Tian's rebellion in his house. Feng falls in love with Tian's granddaughter and marries her. When he finds the proofs and tries to leave with her, his wife is killed in the fight against Tian. Feng creates the mantis-style martial arts and vows to avenge her death.

programme.title: The Lark
programme.desc: Sixties pop star Carrie Ku plays the "Little Lark" in this romantic-drama of mistaken identity that is a treasure trove of some of the most popular Mandarin songs of all time.

programme.title: The Dragon Creek
programme.desc: This wuxia murder mystery film talks about a young girl whose father was ruthlessly murdered during China's early republican era. She has a list of villains who have been plotting against her father and together with her elder brother, the young girl sets out on a journey to hunt down the secret serial killer.

programme.title: The 82 Tenants
programme.desc: Continuing the success of the classic comedy "House of 72 tenants", this sequel tells the stories of tenants living in an old building in Hong Kong who are forced to evict by the developers. Some tenants prefer to take the compensation while some resist the move. Will the acquisitions plan destroy the harmony of the neighborhood?

programme.title: Shadow Girl
programme.desc: A young swordswoman becomes invisible during the day and a monster at night after taking her grandma's pill. She ruined the wedding of a bandit chief's daughter using her powers and is hunted down by them for revenge. Will she escape the hunt?

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao's house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao's descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Bloody Parrot
programme.desc: A swordsman is suspected of being the thief of a treasure sent to Emperor. Through his investigation, he is led on to the trail of the supernatural "Bloody Parrot". Poisonous things happen including a demonic possession, witches casting poison spells and disgusting autopsies. Then a dead constable turns into a vampire!

programme.title: Bloody Parrot
programme.desc: A swordsman is suspected of being the thief of a treasure sent to Emperor. Through his investigation, he is led on to the trail of the supernatural "Bloody Parrot". Poisonous things happen including a demonic possession, witches casting poison spells and disgusting autopsies. Then a dead constable turns into a vampire!

programme.title: Till the End of Time
programme.desc: Ming marries singer Ling, defying his wealthy father and severing family ties. When Ling becomes pregnant, Ming's overwork causes him to lose his sight. To support their home, Ling returns to the stage but Ming leaves to avoid becoming a burden. Encouraged by a friend, Ling performs again, and her song moves Ming to reunite with his wife and child.

programme.title: The Grand Substitution
programme.desc: In this Opera epic, a loyal Imperial Court servant gives up his own newborn son to save the prince from an evil official.

programme.title: Raw Courage
programme.desc: After the Ming Emperor is overthrown and his infant son was put in the care of the Black Dragon Society, a traitorous martial arts clan attacks the society, forcing an inexperienced pair of swordsman and swordswoman to flee with the infant. Their journey to deliver the infant to safety is filled with dangers that would require help from other allies...

programme.title: The Deadly Duo
programme.desc: The prince of the Sung Dynasty is captured by the Chin invaders and guarded by top martial arts masters. Two powerful patriots need to fight the overwhelming odds and pull off the impossible: to rescue the royal Prince and get out of the Chin stronghold alive.

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friend's son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares him away. A rich guy who likes Ye meanwhile pretends as Mu to attend the wedding...

programme.title: The Emperor and his Brother
programme.desc: The Emperor Qianlong is not the legitimate successor to the throne at birth, but he only learns the truth when two senior members of a subversive anti-government secret organisation contact him years later. As it happens, the chef of this organisation is Qianlong's younger brother and they must now confront each other in opposing roles...

programme.title: Fangs of the Cobra
programme.desc: Incredibly, the title serpent is not a harbinger of horror, but actually the film's hero. This virtuous viper sniffs out bombs, fights gangs, battles a baby-killing rodent and even takes on a duplicitous woman. This one-of-a-kind thriller will be applauded by reptile fans everywhere.

programme.title: One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: Accepted to the Golden Sword School after his father sacrificed his life to save his master, Fang Kang is resented by his fellow pupils and decides to leave. His master's daughter challenges him to a fight and cuts off his arm. Fang masters the art of sword fighting with one arm and finds himself returning to the School to save his master again.

programme.title: Crocodile River
programme.desc: This story has a Romeo and Juliet flavour. Two families who hate each other live across the opposite sides of a river filled with crocodiles and do not bother to have a bridge built. Their respective children meet in university and fall in love, but have to find ways to be together and resolve the hatred between their families.

programme.title: The Imperial Swordsman
programme.desc: Fu is a government officer heading home after being charged with falsifying reports. En route, he encounters &amp; recruits a skilled swordsman as a bodyguard. They then meet a fleeing bride and her maid who asked to join them for protection. When the group reach a ruined temple however, a gang of assassins appear and attack them...

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: In the Ming Dynasty, scholar Tian Yu Chuan defends a fisherman's honour but accidentally kills the governor's son, driving him into exile. Pursued to the river's edge, he is rescued by the fisherman's daughter. Amid danger, love blossoms between them, and Tian seals their bond with his family heirloom, the Butterfly Chalice.

programme.title: Martial Arts of Shaolin
programme.desc: Zhi Ming, who trains at the Northern Shaolin Temple, teams up with Si Ma Yan, who trains at the Southern Shaolin Temple, to avenge both their fathers' death by assassinating a corrupt magistrate, leading to a series of fierce battles!

programme.title: Black Magic
programme.desc: Hsu Lo is up against an evil black magic practitioner San Kan Mi, who wants to place a death spell on him and a love spell on his fiancee Wang Chu Ying. Fortunately, Wang's friends manage to find another veteran witch doctor to take on the evil San. This bone-chilling tale of good versus evil races to a heart-stopping ending.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley's mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him...

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man's matchless fighting skills are revered all over China. Set during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man is forced to leave his home and work to support his family. With only his martial arts skills, he reluctantly agrees to train others in the art of Wing Chun for self-defense.

programme.title: Get in the Dark
programme.desc: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao's spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll's eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from real events. Detective Lin sets up a special unit to arrest the motorbike robber and the crime syndicate behind the thefts in Foshan. In the process, his pregnant wife is hit by a motorbike robber, leading him to uncover their revenge plan...

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a "super pill" invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B's superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: Drunken Master
programme.desc: After provoking the son of a local tyrant, young Wong Fei Hung is sent by his father to train under Drunken Master Beggar So. When his father uncovers the tyrant's plot to sell mines to the Japanese, he becomes a target for assassination. To save his father and stop the sale, Fei Hung must forge his own "Drunken Fist" style to defeat the killers.

programme.title: Young Heroes of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Directed by the acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar Wai, this epic action feature begins in Foshan when Ip Man, the martial arts master from the south, takes up a challenge by ageing northern master Gong Yu Tian. Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tian's daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond...

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Directed by the acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar Wai, this epic action feature begins in Foshan when Ip Man, the martial arts master from the south, takes up a challenge by ageing northern master Gong Yu Tian. Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tian's daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond...

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud's successor as the city's guard.

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: Famous director Ho Meng-hua, who gave Jackie Chan and Sammo Hung acting breaks in his early kung-fu films, broke new ground with his horror hit Oily Maniac. Based on a true story about a creature that kills people at night and covers them in oil, it stars young actor Danny Lee (aka. Li Hsiu-hsien) as the oily maniac. It was considered so scary that it was censored drastically.

programme.title: Zombie Island
programme.desc: Jeff, a big fan of zombies, goes to a deserted and mysterious island with his friends hoping to seek out exciting adventures. What started as an adventure turns out to be a horrifying journey as they get trapped on the island and are attacked by the zombies! Their lives are in danger when they fail to fight back, and the game has only just begun!

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao's enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei's concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find "The Sutra of 42 Chapters". Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called "Kung Fu Stuntmen". This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in time to 500 years ago to kill the Dragon Master, in order to reverse the act. Little did she know that the Dragon King and Dragon Master were close friends back then...

programme.title: Fight Back to School
programme.desc: SDU officer Chow Sing Sing goes undercover at a school to locate a missing gun. With his partner Tat, he successfully recovers the weapon, only to stumble upon a munitions smuggling ring. In retaliation, the smugglers storm the school and take students hostage, forcing Sing to risk everything to save them.

programme.title: Fierce Cop
programme.desc: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang relentlessly hunts them down and accidentally finds himself implicated in a major child abduction case. In the process, he teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperor's eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Bodyguard Long Wei has post‐traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firm's VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his father's land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: She is in Danger
programme.desc: After a fight with her boyfriend, Xue leaves home to stay in a remote B&amp;B accommodation, together with a roommate Yi. One night, Xue accidentally discovers that Yi and another friend have killed Yi's ex-boyfriend, and is locked up by the duo so as to cover up the murder. Xue's buddy, Wen, comes seeking for her - can Xue and Wen escape from danger?

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister's daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man...

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughter's company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: The Stormriders
programme.desc: Driven by prophecy, Lord Conqueror murders Wind and Cloud's parents, then raises the boys as his own. Years later, their power rivals his, so he secretly plots their deaths. However, when his daughter falls for both young men, jealousy ignites. The moment he betroths her to Wind, a fatal battle becomes inevitable.

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Man's father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes...

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident...

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xin's ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels
programme.desc: Conman Sing is forced by a loan shark to team up with another con artist Betty to steal from a luxurious house. When they encounter other conmen who disguise themselves as the house owners to steal the antiques, they pretend to be their rich guests. As both sides know the other's true identity, they join forces to con the loan shark into a trap.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - Slow Boat to England
programme.desc: Po and Blade head to the docks to take Klaus and Veruca to England, and Po tries to have fun with her on their last day together. However, Klaus and Veruca break free and hold Po hostage; Blade shockingly gives up the location of the fire whip to save him.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Knight's Fall - Part 1
programme.desc: Po and Blade rush to warn the Emperor about the weasels, but he has Po arrested and Colin captures Blade, revealing that she was never a knight. Thrown in a cell, Po reunites with Rukhmini and Mr. Ping, and he copes with the truth about Blade as they break out. Po fights Klaus and Veruca but is outmatched. Blade defeats Colin and hurries to help Po but is too late.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - A Glorious End, Part Two
programme.desc: In the final battle against Morando, Aja and Krel must make an unexpected sacrifice to win the day to save their Akiridion and Earthen homes.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Terra Incognita Part One
programme.desc: The evil General Morando launches a coup on the alien planet Akiridion-5. In the ensuing battle, the planet's King and Queen are severely injured, and their surviving son Krel and daughter Aja escape the planet with military commander, Varvatos Vex. They seek refuge on a backwater planet: Earth.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Terra Incognita Part Two
programme.desc: Aja, Krel, and Vex explore Earth looking for technology to repair their ship. When the high school Principal demands to meet Aja and Krel's guardians, the Royal teens transform two maintenance robots (Blanks) to pose as their "human" parents.

programme.title: Turbo F.A.S.T. S1 - The Terror Of Tickula Prank'd
programme.desc: Turbo and Whiplash meet a strange tick who may be out to harm Turbo.When the crew starts a prank war, Chet is nervous that he is the next target.

programme.title: Turbo F.A.S.T. S1 - Over Shadowed Beware The Chickipede
programme.desc: White Shadow quits racing and it's up to Turbo to convince him to get back on the track.The crew becomes detectives and meets a strange new creature.

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing S1 - House of the Future Dr. Buttersocks
programme.desc: Loy upgrades the house with a few seemingly helpful robotic enhancements. Archibald becomes a sock-puppet wrestling superstar.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Messed-Up Painting
programme.desc: Queen Sparklewings has done a beautiful painting to use in her Story-Time afternoon. But then Coco and Noddy discover it ruined! Coco thinks that Bling must have done it but she protests her innocence. Noddy investigates: who messed up the Queen's painting - and can he get it fixed again in time? Keep investigating, Noddy!

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Deltoid's Challenge
programme.desc: Deltoid accepts the Ninja's challenge to run around the loop-theloop. But when he fails on his first attempt, he feels ready to give up in despair. Noddy investigates: How can he help Deltoid do his challenge?

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Knights On Patrol
programme.desc: The Knights set off on their patrol but are delayed by someone playing tricks on them. Noddy investigates: who's playing tricks on the Knights? He soon finds them in Fable Forest, waylaid by yet another cheeky trick. Noddy will have to find the culprit before the Knights end up in serious trouble!

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Delayed Repairs
programme.desc: The railway tracks are being repaired all over Toyland by the Builders, so Farmer Tom, Tractor and a trailer are running a replacement service. But the repairs take longer than expected when the Builders' tools go missing. Noddy investigates, and finds that Cloppycorn loved the trailer rides so much that he hid the biolders' tools in a basket that Pat-Pat had asked him to take to the other Naughticorns.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Vulture Is Bald
programme.desc: You see there was time when Vulture was not bald. Oh no, Vulture's head was covered in a beautiful crown of golden plumage! Vain Vulture never shut up about her golden feathers and was obsessed about making them ‘as golden as the sun!'. One day Vulture decides to fly up to the sun, but her precious feathers get burnt! Vulture decides to sooth her smoking feathers with golden honey which she steals from the bees. The bees are not pleased and Vulture sticks her head down Aardvark's burrow.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Giraffe Has A Long Neck
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Giraffe didn't have a long neck. Her neck was all short and stumpy and she was a very delicate eater. All the food in Tinga Tinga seemed to make her tummy go funny. Then one day Lion suggests she try some honey. With the Bees permission, Giraffe tries to lick the honey… but it is deep, deep inside the tree.

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service S3 - Postman Pat And The Space Suit
programme.desc: It's a snowy day in Greendale, and Ted Glen has invited the kids to his workshop to meet his friend, space expert Professor Farrow. Julian's excited but so is Pat, who has always yearned to be an astronaut. He's even more thrilled when he finds that his special delivery is a space suit - an extra surprise for the kids. When his van breaks down in a snowy lane, he finds an ingenious solution - only to suffer a puncture - and Ted is unable to help...

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service S3 - Postman Pat And The Stormy Birthday
programme.desc: It's Chris Beacon's birthday and he's looking forward to spending the day onshore and having a party at the village hall. Pat's SDS mission is to pick up all the presents from everyone who won't be able to be at the party later.

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Home Is Where The Hatch Is
programme.desc: Breeze and Roary swap places for the day (and night). Roary soon discovers the beach is no place for a racing car to live, while Breeze misses the freedom of the beach.

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Putting On A Show
programme.desc: The cars are all gleaming for this evening's race. Roary gets bored and heads out onto the track - with disastrous consequences. Will the cars be ready in time for the big show?

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Motor Mouth
programme.desc: The track inspector is coming to visit and Big Chris is too tired to commentate on the race. A celebrity commentator is brought in to save the day - much to Big Chris' anger.

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Dancing Queen
programme.desc: Christine is due to take part in a dancing competition and is practising at Silver Hatch. But what happens when her dance partner is taken ill?

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Big Pile of Cabbages
programme.desc: When Noddy comes to give Smartysaurus an invitation to Queen Sparklewings's picnic, there's a big pile of cabbages blocking her front door. Noddy investigates: who left the big pile of cabbages there and why? And will he be able to solve the case in time for the Royal Picnic?

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Queen's Special Gift
programme.desc: The Knights have been away travelling around Toyland and they each return with a special gift for the Queen. But the last Knight to arrive back was so busy having fun that he forgot to bring back a present for the Queen. Noddy assures him the Queen won't mind but the poor Knight is adamant he must give her something. Noddy sets out to help him find the perfect gift.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case of the Pirates' Missing Treasure
programme.desc: When the Pockets find an old treasure map, the Pirates are delighted. They race off to find the treasure. Only to come back rather confused. They found a treasure chest but it ran away! Noddy investigates: "What's happened to the Pirates' treasure?"

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Frozen Toys
programme.desc: Noddy and Big Ears come to Fable Forest to see the Queen Sparklewings's magic crystal collection. But when they arrive at the Fairy Castle, they find all the toys there frozen like statues. What's going on. It's up to Noddy to investigate and help his friends return to their normal selves.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - It's Purrsday!
programme.desc: It's Purrsday, the happiest cat day of the year, and all the Gabby Cats have a special purrsday surprise. Gabby and Pandy make peekaboo kitty paper chains with Baby Box, decorate a Purrsday cake with Cakey, Gabby gets a special kitty makeover with Mercat, and everyone sings a Purrsday song with DJ Catnip. For the COTD, DJ Catnip shows us how to make a DJ Catnip purr-stick!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Doodlebook
programme.desc: Gabby unboxes a cup of crayons and a coloring book with the same doodle on every page. When she takes it into The dollhouse each of the Gabby Cats sees something different in the doodle and turns it into a uniquely magical drawing. But when CatRat gets stuck inside the book, Gabby and Pandy must go on a doodle rescue mission to save him.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - King Burple
programme.desc: After Burple and Cutter crash-land in a village of tiny dragons, Burple's unintentional act of courage leads the locals to crown him as their king.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Charged Up
programme.desc: Magnus's superpowered mechano-dragon threatens to replace the Riders. But when it spirals out of control, the town's real heroes have to step up!

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - You (Don't) Snooze, You Lose Save The Squasher
programme.desc: When the crew takes on a mission to help Ian get some rest for a Badminton Tournament, Jax realises that the biggest approach isn't always the best approach. When Lula loses her comic book, Ari learns that the best heroes rely on teamwork and not gadgets.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Flying High Nest Sweet Nest
programme.desc: Marcus makes a Dew Drop-sized hot-air balloon for Phoebe and the Dews have a blast helping their kids from above, including secretly guiding Lola back to her family, before she accidentally follows Hip-Hop the frog out of the park. Phoebe makes a pair of glasses for Bob the bird, but when seeing things clearly for the first time gets him lost, the Dews help Bob find his nest before his family arrives for a visit.

programme.desc: When Noddy comes to give Smartysaurus an invitation to Queen Sparklewings's picnic, there's a big pile of cabbages blocking her front door. Noddy investigates: who left the big pile of cabbages there and why? And will he be able to solve the case in time for the Royal Picnic?
